name: umo-jira-tracker
description: UMO JIRA Tracker — links JIRA tickets to a local Beads database, automates sprint sync, drives commit/MR creation with STD-JIRA naming, and syncs results back to JIRA on bead close or MR creation.

interface.shortDescription: Sprint sync, JIRA↔Beads bridge, commit/MR creation, and JIRA sync-back.
interface.longDescription: Automates the daily developer JIRA workflow: syncs your unresolved sprint tickets into a local Beads database, maps Epics/Stories/Tasks into the bead hierarchy, guides bead-by-bead work with AC drafting, creates GitLab MRs via glab (or GitLab MCP) using STD-JIRA naming, and syncs outcomes (MR links, transitions, new sub-tasks) back to JIRA — all with explicit approval gates.
defaultPrompt: Run /umo-jira-tracker:sync to pull my unresolved JIRA tickets into Beads.
Run /umo-jira-tracker:work CWN-1234 to start working on a ticket.
Run /umo-jira-tracker:mr to create a GitLab MR and update JIRA.
Run /umo-jira-tracker:close to close the bead and transition JIRA.
